title: Thread Boundaries and Send
goal: Choose container types that satisfy the Send bound for multi-threaded state.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Send and Sync

hints: The compiler checks whether captured variables implement the Send trait before allowing them into a spawned thread.
Rc is non-atomic and cannot implement Send, even when wrapped in a Mutex. Use Arc for thread-safe reference counting.
explanation: Arc provides atomic reference counting, which implements Send when wrapping a Mutex. Rc uses non-atomic counters, so wrapping it in a Mutex still results in a non-Send type that triggers E0277. Using Box allocates a separate mutex for each clone, causing threads to mutate independent counters so the test fails.
